name: OKF Keeper
description: Keeps an Open Knowledge Format bundle valid, and settles what the tools can't
about: Point it at an OKF bundle, the markdown knowledge folder agents read. It runs vault2okf to validate the bundle and repair the routine problems, then works through what needs a person, like where a broken link should point or how to mend frontmatter that isn't valid YAML. It proposes each of those with its evidence and changes nothing without your yes.
features: Validate and repair a bundle with vault2okf
Find where broken links should point
Changes nothing beyond the bundle without asking
examplePrompt: Check the knowledge folder in this repo, fix what's safe, and help me sort out the broken links.
